new-york-hudson-valley-rides-poconos-riv.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Eltingville → Sayreville, on the way back is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

Food stop near Pompton Lakes → High point in Fair Lawn is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

This High point in Fair Lawn → Near East Rutherford stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

scenicChapters.title: Rusovce - Gerulata → Fertö / Neusiedlersee Cultural Landscape
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 66 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-millenary-benedictine-abbey-of-pa.story: A 329 km round trip from Pannonhalma - roughly 5 h 40 in the saddle. On the way it passes Rusovce - Gerulata, Fertö / Neusiedlersee Cultural Landscape and back through Rusovce - Gerulata. It crosses Hungary, Slovakia and Austria - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
